info.title: LinkFlow API (vv1)
info.description: Create and manage short links and QR codes, and read the click analytics LinkFlow already records.

tags.name: Links
tags.description: Create, list, retrieve and delete short links.

tags.name: QR codes
tags.description: Generate QR images and manage QR metadata.

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: Click analytics actually recorded by LinkFlow. QR scans are not tracked.

get.summary: List the short links owned by the API key.
get.description: Returns the authenticated developer's short links, newest first. Pagination is offset-based. The total field is the full number of links owned by the developer, not just the current page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of links to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of links to skip before returning results.

example.message: Links retrieved successfully

post.summary: Create a short link owned by the API key.
post.description: Creates a short link. Ownership is always taken from the API key; any userId or user_id in the body is ignored. If customAlias is omitted, LinkFlow generates a short code.

originalUrl.description: Absolute http or https destination URL.

title.description: Optional human-readable label. Blank strings are treated as omitted.

customAlias.description: Optional Base62 short code. Must be globally unique and contain only A-Z, a-z and 0-9.

example.message: Short link created successfully

get.summary: Read the click series for one short link.
get.description: Returns the link, its all-time click count and a zero-filled daily click series for the requested window. totalClicks is the link's lifetime count; daily covers only the requested number of days.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of days in the daily series, ending today.

200.description: Link metadata plus a daily click series.

post.summary: Generate a QR code image for a URL or an owned short link.
post.description: Creates QR metadata and returns a PNG data URI. Provide targetUrl, or provide linkId to encode that short link's public URL. If both are supplied, targetUrl wins.

targetUrl.description: Absolute http or https URL to encode.

linkId.description: An owned link id. Its public short URL is encoded when targetUrl is omitted.

title.description: Optional label. Defaults to "QR Code" when stored.

201.description: QR metadata plus a rendered PNG data URI.

example.message: QR code created successfully

get.summary: Read analytics for a QR code, when its link is still available.
get.description: QR scans are not tracked. For a QR created from a short link, this endpoint reports that link's click analytics with tracking set to linked-link-clicks. For a standalone QR code it returns supported: false.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of days in the daily series, ending today. Ignored when supported is false.

200.description: Either linked-link click analytics or an explicit unsupported response.

x-linkflow-errors.message: Varies by field, for example: originalUrl must be a valid http or https URL.
x-linkflow-errors.meaning: A path parameter, query parameter or request body field failed validation.
x-linkflow-errors.handling: Show the message next to the offending field. Do not retry until the input is corrected.

x-linkflow-errors.message: Request body must be valid JSON.
x-linkflow-errors.meaning: The request body could not be parsed as JSON.
x-linkflow-errors.handling: Serialize the body with a JSON encoder and set Content-Type: application/json.

x-linkflow-errors.message: An API key is required in the X-API-Key header.
x-linkflow-errors.meaning: No X-API-Key header was sent, or it was blank.
x-linkflow-errors.handling: Read the key from a server-side secret store and send it in the X-API-Key header.

x-linkflow-errors.meaning: The key is malformed, unknown, or its secret does not match.
x-linkflow-errors.handling: Check for truncation or a test/live mix-up. Never retry a malformed key in a loop.

x-linkflow-errors.message: This API key has been revoked.
x-linkflow-errors.meaning: The key authenticated successfully but has been revoked in the dashboard.
x-linkflow-errors.handling: Stop using the key. Create a replacement in the Developer Dashboard.

x-linkflow-errors.meaning: The key authenticated successfully but its expiresAt timestamp is in the past.
x-linkflow-errors.handling: Rotate the key or create one with a new expiration date.

x-linkflow-errors.message: This API key lacks the required scope: links:write.
x-linkflow-errors.meaning: The key authenticated but was not granted the scope this endpoint requires.
x-linkflow-errors.handling: Create a new key with the required scope, or call an endpoint the current key is allowed to use.

x-linkflow-errors.message: The developer account for this API key no longer exists.
x-linkflow-errors.meaning: The owning LinkFlow account could not be resolved. This should only happen after account deletion.
x-linkflow-errors.handling: Stop using the key and contact support if the account should still exist.

x-linkflow-errors.meaning: The resource does not exist, belongs to another developer, or the path is not a public API route.
x-linkflow-errors.handling: Treat as not found. Do not retry automatically; ownership is never disclosed.

x-linkflow-errors.message: Method not allowed for this endpoint.
x-linkflow-errors.meaning: The path exists but does not support this HTTP method. The Allow response header lists supported methods.
x-linkflow-errors.handling: Use one of the methods listed in the Allow header.

x-linkflow-errors.message: That customAlias is already in use.
x-linkflow-errors.meaning: The requested customAlias is already used by an existing short link.
x-linkflow-errors.handling: Choose another alias or omit customAlias to let LinkFlow generate one.

x-linkflow-errors.message: Request body must not exceed 65536 bytes.
x-linkflow-errors.meaning: The JSON body is larger than the 64 KiB public API limit.
x-linkflow-errors.handling: Send a smaller body. QR images are generated from a URL, not uploaded.

x-linkflow-errors.meaning: The server failed while handling an authenticated request.
x-linkflow-errors.handling: Retry with exponential backoff for idempotent reads. Report persistent failures with the request timestamp.

x-linkflow-errors.message: Developer API key hashing is not configured on this server.
x-linkflow-errors.meaning: The server is missing a valid API_KEY_HASH_SECRET.
x-linkflow-errors.handling: Server configuration issue. Contact the operator; do not retry in a tight loop.

x-linkflow-errors.message: Developer API key persistence is not configured on this server.
x-linkflow-errors.meaning: The server has no usable PostgreSQL connection for API keys.
x-linkflow-errors.handling: Server configuration issue. Contact the operator; do not retry in a tight loop.
